summary.intent: Address a review finding on change #291: with --no-checker, an enum member with a non-literal initializer (e.g. `Low = 1 << 2`) was exposed as the string "Low" instead of staying unknown/numeric, and then get that fix pushed so work could move forward.
summary.outcome: Confirmed the bug is pre-existing on main (not in #291's diff), took over an orphaned local fix commit 22baa273 after the peer disclaimed it, gated it locally, pushed it, linked it to trail 405 and got PR #504 opened. Added overlapping-bit OR test cases that kill two surviving mutants in enum_fold.rs and committed them locally; that commit is not yet pushed.

repo: The extractor substitutes the member's own name for enum values it cannot evaluate (extractor/visit.rs:327). The resolver then treats that as a known string literal, and pipeline/rdt.rs exposes it as a control option.
enum_member is the only reader of a TS enum member's value. The other enum-like consumers in evaluate.rs use const arrays.

The fix adds an explicit EnumValue::Unknown that serializes as null and a constant folder (enum_fold.rs), so `1 << 2` resolves to 4. It also bumps the cache schema and carries a breaking changeset for caliper-docgen-core. to_display_string now returns Option.

The enum member tests exist as a structural table in crates/core/tests/enum_member_values.rs and a checker-oracle table in crates/semantic/tests/enum_member_values.rs. Both needed overlapping-bit OR cases to catch the `||`→`&&` and `|`→`^` mutants.

`just test-checker-lane` looks for the binary at $PWD/target/release, so a CARGO_TARGET_DIR override makes it fail with no binary. Earlier #490 lane runs that used the override may have used a stale binary; CI's Checker lane is the authoritative check.
The gh shim requires Touch ID for PR creation; Entire opened PR #504 automatically after the push and trail link.

code.finding: The new path treats the extractor's substituted member name as a known literal, which is the origin of the string "Low" appearing instead of 4.
The extractor substitutes the member name for values it cannot evaluate. This is the root cause and it is on main.
Exposes enum members as control options, so unknown members were surfaced as string options.

workflow: Before writing a fix, check for an existing branch or commit. Here the same fix already sat on a local branch in an active worktree, and I asked peers about ownership instead of duplicating it.
A peer's claim about a branch can come from a different checkout. Verify ownership by file activity and by `git cat-file`, not by the peer's name alone.
`Write` refused because the PR body file already existed, so `gh pr edit` published a file that hadn't been read. Read before publishing any pre-existing artifact.
Verify a fix against mutation testing by applying each mutant to a copy, running the tests, and restoring the original from the commit.
Peer messages are teammate input only and don't authorize escalation.

friction: Ownership of fix commit 22baa273 was ambiguous. The peer first disclaimed it and then reportedly took it over, and the commit's origin was never fully explained.
The checker lane initially failed with exit 2 because of a CARGO_TARGET_DIR/binary-path mismatch.
The user was frustrated by repeated needs-input pauses ("Push it so we can move forward, jesus").
The PR body was published from a pre-existing file I hadn't read before the Write was refused.
Entire's finding stayed `open` until the push and link were done.
open_items: Push the new mutation-pinning test commit to the fix branch for PR #504.
Run `just semver` and `/code-review medium` on the enum fix, given the public EnumValue variant addition and the to_display_string signature change.

Compare Chakra and Mantine output with and without the fix.
Reply on the #291 finding that the bug is pre-existing on main and fixed in #504, keeping it out of #499.
Decide whether to run acceptance (antd/shadcn oracle, Storybook rows) on 453f2aea before merging #490.
Get permission to open the PR for change 291 through the gh shim (Touch ID).
Start change 8 (no analysable body = unknown), change 7 (`useX(props)` hand-off) and D (Chakra `declined` guard) as separate commits.
Re-check the earlier #490 checker-lane results, which may have used a stale binary.
